description:
Five Little Monkeys: Why Gravity Always Pulls You Down! — Five little monkeys jumping on the bed, one fell off! But why do things always fall DOWN and never float UP?
Kids science answer for "five little monkeys jumping on the bed rhyme" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

When a monkey jumps up, Earth's invisible super-magnet called gravity pulls everything straight down toward the center of the planet.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
